messages:
anya_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock priorities for model-catalog lifecycle work next quarter. Focus areas I heard: onboarding UX, standardized benchmarks, version pinning + rollback UX, and deprecation/migration flows. Thoughts?

matt_eng: +1. Need criteria to rank these. Is customer impact > operational risk?

sara_ml: For ranking: customer impact, regression risk, and frequency of hits (how often requests hit the model). Also technical effort estimate.

jordan_cs: Customers are asking specifically for nonbreaking pinning and a predictable migration window. We get tickets when deployed models change out from under them.

lee_docs: Also a docs ask: schema for model-cards + changelog automation. Without that, CS/SEs can't communicate migrations cleanly.

matt_eng: Proposal: break into three deliverables: (1) onboarding checklist + template + auto-validator, (2) pinning API + UI + canary rollout, (3) deprecation API + migration assistant + customer-notify hooks. Each has a small spike first.

anya_pm: Agree. Suggest prioritization matrix: customer impact (0-5), regression risk (0-5), engineering effort (0-5, inverted), observability needs (0-3). We'll sum weighted score: impact*3 + risk*2 + effort*1 + obs*1.

sara_ml: For onboarding acceptance criteria: every onboarded model must include a model-card JSON, automated benchmark artifact (latency P50/P95, token cost, embedding drift against reference set), a regression run (key prompt suite — <2% quality drop vs baseline), and a runnable artifact (container or package).

matt_eng: For pinning: need a DB schema to map customer->route->pinned_model_version, pin TTLs, and an API: POST /pins, GET /pins, POST /pins/migrate. Also support feature flags: enable-per-customer canary. Example snippet:```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_123",
  "route": "/chat/gpt",
  "pin_version": "v1.4.2",
  "expires_at": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"
}```

catalog-bot: catalog-bot: index update: new staging model 'redwood-optic-13b-v2' added (sha256:fa3...c0).

jordan_cs: For migrations: customers want a migration preview (runs their prompt set on new model with diff), scheduled migration windows, and automatic fallback if quality regressions detected.

anya_pm: Draft timeline suggestion: Milestone 1 (6 weeks): onboarding validator + model-card templates + docs. Milestone 2 (8 weeks): pin API + UI + canary. Milestone 3 (6 weeks): deprecation workflow + migration preview tool + customer-notify integration. Target end date for full rollout: end of Q2 2026.

matt_eng: Owners: infra/serving -> matt_eng; benching & eval harness -> sara_ml; docs + templates -> lee_docs; customer comms -> jordan_cs. I'll book 1.5 engineer-months scoped for DB + API work in spike.

lee_docs: Can we get a short customer-facing template for migration notices? I can draft samples if you drop the acceptance criteria.

sara_ml: Also callout: automated eval harness needs storage for per-customer prompt sets and encrypted results, plus retention policy. That affects privacy/compliance.

anya_pm: Good catch — add security/compliance signoff step before any public migration tools. Jordan, loop in legal for regulated customers.

jordan_cs: Will do. I'll compile a top-10 customer ask list and prioritize by revenue + number of affected routes.

matt_eng: One more technical note: we should support soft-pins so customers can opt into fallback tiers (e.g., prefer v2 but allow v1 on regressions). Implementation detail for spike.

anya_pm: Nice. Action items: 1) owners acknowledged (matt/sara/lee/jordan) 2) I’ll create a short PRD with prioritization matrix and scorecards by EOD tomorrow 3) spike tickets to estimate effort. :thumbsup:

catalog-bot: catalog-bot: reminder: weekly catalog index job runs every Monday 04:00 UTC.

matt_eng: Sounds good — will add DB schema draft to the PRD.

lee_docs: I'll draft the migration notice templates and a changelog example. Will post in this thread when ready.

anya_pm: Thanks everyone — posting PRD link when done and will schedule sync if needed.

jordan_cs: Thanks — will gather customer impact list and share by Friday.
_notes: Document follows agents.md: single continuous string with messages prefixed by display names. No title field.
